form.label: Initial Setup
form.description: First-run initialization of KV Store inventory, last-seen baseline and canonical monitoring state.

init.set: Verifying inventory, last-seen observations and canonical state.

search.query: | eventcount summarize=false index=* | stats sum(count) AS events BY index | where index!="_internal" AND index!="_audit" AND index!="_introspection" | sort 0 index | fields index

| inputlookup lsw_inventory | stats count AS Inventory | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_lastseen | stats count AS Last_seen ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_state | stats count AS State ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_audit | stats count AS Audit ] | eval Missing_observation=if(Inventory>Last_seen,Inventory-Last_seen,0) | eval Banner_class=case( Inventory=0,"lsw-setup-status--required", State!=Inventory,"lsw-setup-status--attention", true(),"lsw-setup-status--success" ) | eval Banner_title=case( Inventory=0,"Initial Setup Required", State!=Inventory,"Initial Setup Needs Attention", true(),"Log Source Watch Successfully Initialized" ) | eval Banner_detail=case( Inventory=0,"No monitored sources are registered yet. Select an index, baseline and silence threshold, then initialize Log Source Watch.", State!=Inventory,"Inventory contains ".Inventory." sources but canonical state contains ".State.". Rebuild the state before relying on monitoring results.", Missing_observation>0,"Monitoring is initialized for ".Inventory." sources. ".Last_seen." currently have a last-seen observation and ".Missing_observation." are tracked as NO LOG OBSERVATION.", true(),"Monitoring is initialized for ".Inventory." sources and canonical state is complete. Continue to Overview, then use Management → Discover to add additional indexes and hosts." ) | fields Inventory Last_seen State Audit Banner_class Banner_title Banner_detail

div.p: Verify the packaged KV Store schema, enroll the first source scope, seed latest observations and build canonical state.

html.div: Safe first run: recurring schedulers are enabled but last-seen collection remains fail-closed until inventory contains active or maintenance sources. Initial Setup enrolls only the selected first index; add further source scopes later from Management → Discover.

Splunk query confirmations: Splunk can show warnings for packaged administrative searches elsewhere in the app. Accept a warning only when you intentionally started that Log Source Watch action. Initial Setup itself uses read-only discovery plus authenticated KV Store writes and does not rely on a hidden outputlookup dashboard search.

search.query: | inputlookup lsw_inventory | stats count AS Inventory | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_lastseen | stats count AS Last_seen ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_state | stats count AS State ] | appendcols [ | inputlookup lsw_audit | stats count AS Audit ] | eval Status=case(Inventory=0,"SETUP REQUIRED",State!=Inventory,"ATTENTION",true(),"READY") | table Status Inventory Last_seen State Audit

| inputlookup lsw_inventory | stats count AS records | eval collection="lsw_inventory" | append [ | inputlookup lsw_lastseen | stats count AS records | eval collection="lsw_lastseen" ] | append [ | inputlookup lsw_state | stats count AS records | eval collection="lsw_state" ] | append [ | inputlookup lsw_audit | stats count AS records | eval collection="lsw_audit" ] | eval availability="OK" | table collection availability records

| tstats latest(_time) AS last_seen WHERE index=$setup_index|s$ earliest=$setup_earliest|s$ latest=now BY index host | where $setup_index|s$!="-" AND len(host)>0 | eval _key=sha256(index."|".host) | lookup local=true lsw_inventory _key OUTPUT status AS existing_status threshold_seconds AS existing_threshold | eval registration=if(isnull(existing_status),"NEW","REGISTERED"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table index host registration existing_status existing_threshold last_seen | sort 0 registration host

div.p: Initialize Log Source Watch discovers the selected index with a read-only search, enrolls those index/host sources as the first monitoring scope, writes lsw_inventory, lsw_lastseen, lsw_state and lsw_audit through the authenticated app KV Store API, and leaves the packaged five-minute schedulers running for ongoing monitoring.
Next: after initialization you are taken to Overview. Use Management → Discover to enroll additional indexes and hosts; Initial Setup is not intended to be repeated for every index.
KV Store collections and fields are defined by the application package. No manual KV Store creation is required.
